sophie_sales: Quick kickoff 1: Ellie's team wants to swap from CompetitorX -> Redwood. They need a short POC: parity checks, cost delta, and answers to a security questionnaire. @dan_se can you run tech?

dan_se: Yes. Ask them for their top 30 prompts, example traces, and which endpoints they call (chat vs completions). Also need peak rps and token distro.

ellie_client: We'll send scrubbed traces and a 30-prompt file. Primary endpoints: /v1/chat and /v1/completions. Peak ~220 rps. Sending to your email now.

ops-bot: staging org created for thread 1725556666: ellie-poc-stg (keys expire in 7 days).

dryan_sec: Security note: they requested KMS + SOC2 scope and egress IPs. Please have them submit the questionnaire; turnaround ~48-72h after we get it.

mira_prod: Mapping note: competitor's "fast" model roughly maps to rwd-lite; we'll include prompt-normalization snippets to reduce response variance.

dan_se: POC sketch: day 0 onboarding, day 1 smoke 500 side-by-side requests, day 2 perf tuning (batching/kv), deliver parity report and cost estimate.

sophie_sales: Pricing: I'll prepare 6mo vs PAYG bands. Ellie: can you confirm procurement timeline?

ellie_client: Need SOW by Thursday. Security will start questionnaire Wed.

sanctions: Action owners: @dan_se produce 1-page POC plan by EOD tomorrow; @ryan_sec ready to review questionnaire; @mira_prod to prepare mapping notes.

sophie_sales: Thanks all 1 I'll send calendar invite for Thu AM.
